scope: Two strict five-cell thermal roots with the same historical physical model, differing only in the declared continuum/angle/line quadratures. This is a falsification of coarse radiation-resolution adequacy, not of the existence of either discrete root.
publication: Raw fine-root and observer artifacts remain local and unpublished. Only this compact review is added to the ordinary PR tree. No remote raw-data URL is asserted.

configuration.outer_boundary: Historical center-ended temperature profile; zero outer advection is not physically validated.
configuration.processing: Same approximate cadence, equal master weights, stellar mask and endpoint extension as examples/cloudy_halpha.py

discrete_root_checks.note: The saved complete residuals and gates were inspected, not rerun by this authoring script. Upper three cells impose energy balance; lower two retain the imposed extension.

independently_recomputed_observer_compar.note: Compare interpolated processed predictions at the same observed velocities using the supplied errors; these errors are only a numerical scale, not a validated likelihood.

retained_interruption.scope: The interrupted earlier process is not a physical or numerical failure; the resumed final root has its own successful complete residual.

limitations: A strict residual verifies a selected discretized equation, not its radiation quadrature accuracy.
The previous observer-grid support remains valid at its unchanged coarse atmosphere; this new control re-solves the atmosphere and exposes a different error source.
The 4/4/8 root is not thereby converged in radiation resolution. Further quadrature repair/refinement must re-solve the complete thermal system and repeat the actual observer.
Radial resolution, revised outer boundary, atomic reduction, qualified Cloudy agreement, observational reduction and inference readiness remain separate.
All six complete-use assessment records and basis digests remain unchanged.
